title: SEKA ExAero RDC structural data
notes: Current exact-model specialist page reports manufacturer comparative figures versus Spear: front lateral stiffness +21.2%, rear lateral stiffness +7.6%, and overall torsional stiffness +13.4%, from 367 to 416. Test protocol and units for the 367/416 values are not disclosed, so these are manufacturer comparative claims rather than independent measurements.
